changes.title: Replies stream in smoothly
changes.body: The agent's words come in at an even pace instead of in bursts, and Thinking no longer flashes once it's done.

changes.title: Find your way around a long change
changes.body: Filter the changed files, see them as a folder tree, and drag the file list wider.

changes.title: The screenshot shortcuts work again
changes.body: ⌘⇧3, ⌘⇧4 and ⌘⇧5 take a screenshot instead of opening a session.

changes.title: Sessions waiting on a command stay under Working
changes.body: A session whose agent watches a CI run or a build it started stays under Working until its turn ends, and its row says what it waits on.

changes.title: Review every project's pull requests in one place
changes.body: Pull requests in the sidebar lists them across your projects; open one to read it, comment on its lines, approve or ask for changes, or have an agent review it.

changes.title: Fix errors says what it's doing
changes.body: While it reads the failed checks' logs or the review's comments, above the message box, and the agent's fix is pushed by itself.

changes.title: Work left in the background shows as it is
changes.body: A session whose helpers work in the background stays under Working.

changes.title: Archiving asks about unpushed work right away
changes.body: Before the session leaves the sidebar, not seconds after you pressed Archive.

changes.title: Long threads keep their place
changes.body: A long conversation is kept when its thread moves or loses its machine, and drafts and messages follow a move.

changes.title: Connected apps stay signed in
changes.body: Apps signed in with OAuth renew their sign-in instead of stopping after an hour.

changes.title: Moving or starting a thread shows above the message box
changes.body: Where it's going and how long it's taking, without filling the chat; your open tabs stay after a move.

changes.title: A waking sandbox shows above the message box
changes.body: As compacting does: where it is and how long it's taking, without filling the chat.

changes.title: Clearer updates from sub-threads
changes.body: Their reports read like the steps around them, and one waiting on a run says when it's back instead of showing as done.

changes.title: Moving a thread to This Mac no longer freezes Ensemble
changes.body: Messages you send right after the move show at once too.

changes.title: Sub-threads are back
changes.body: An agent can hand parts of its work to sub-threads, each on a branch of its own. They show at the top of its chat, ask it or you when they're stuck, and their work is pulled into its branch.

changes.title: See Codex's subagents in the chat
changes.body: What each subagent Codex starts does shows in the chat, as Claude Code's subagents do.

changes.title: The pull request tab opens at the side panel's width
changes.body: The chat keeps most of the window, and the pull request's details line up in one column.

changes.title: Pull requests open beside the chat
changes.body: When a session opens a pull request, it opens as a tab next to the chat, with its checks, review and description.

changes.title: Review changes folder by folder
changes.body: The Changes tab folds by folder and tucks away files you've marked Viewed, so only what's left to review shows.

changes.title: See every command and tool call in full
changes.body: Opening a step shows its whole call and its output line by line, live while it runs.

changes.title: Codex can call on Claude Code in cloud sessions
changes.body: An agent in a cloud session can run the other one, signed in with your account.

changes.title: Faster with screenshots and many chats
changes.body: A message with pasted screenshots sends at once, and switching between chats is instant.

changes.title: Ensemble stays responsive all day
changes.body: The app no longer slows down as notifications pile up in Notification Center.

changes.title: Retry works as soon as your usage limit resets
changes.body: A retry after an early reset now reaches your agent instead of saying every account is out.

changes.title: Codex chats show everything Claude chats do
changes.body: Pages, suggestions to move a session and the diff of each edit now show in a Codex chat too.

changes.title: A reply from a banner answers the question it showed
changes.body: With several chats asking at once, a reply typed in a notification now goes to the chat it came from.

changes.title: A cloud session stays awake while you watch its terminal
changes.body: A dev server or a long test run in the terminal is no longer stopped because nothing was typed.

changes.title: Automations keep to their schedule
changes.body: An automation no longer stops running after one of its sessions is deleted, and renaming one keeps what its triggers were watching.

changes.title: A new Ensemble
changes.body: Sessions, projects and settings rebuilt around one sidebar, with a calmer look: New session at the top, your projects with their counts, and every session with where it stands.

changes.title: Automations
changes.body: Sessions that start on their own: on a schedule, or when a pull request opens, checks fail, an issue gets a label, a Linear issue comes in or Sentry sees a new error.

changes.title: Side-by-side tabs
changes.body: Drag a tab to an edge of a session to open it beside the others, as in VS Code.

changes.title: A terminal in every session
changes.body: Press ⌘J for a shell in the session's own folder.

changes.title: See and free up disk space
changes.body: Each machine's settings show what its sessions take, and clear build output or delete old archived sessions in a click.

changes.title: ⌘K finds everything
changes.body: Sessions, projects, actions and settings in one search, with tabs to narrow it down.

changes.title: A faster first run
changes.body: Set up your agents, GitHub and projects in three steps, with your recent projects and conversations brought in.

changes.title: A chat keeps the model you last used in it
Fable 5.2 in the model menu
changes.body: Fable runs Anthropic's newest model, and Sonnet and Haiku their 5.5 versions.

changes.title: Fable's share of your plan, on its own
changes.body: The usage popover shows how much of the week's Fable allowance each login has used. When it runs out, a Fable chat moves to another login, and chats on other models stay where they are.

changes.title: Choose the branch a thread's work goes into
changes.body: Pick it with "into main" in the Git status panel: the changes, Merge main in and the pull request follow it.

changes.title: Threads and chats open at once
changes.body: No more waiting to sync after an update: your threads are there at once, and a chat opens on its latest messages, loading the earlier ones as you scroll up.

changes.title: Sending a message takes you to it
changes.body: Scrolled up in a chat, sending glides it back down to your message.

changes.title: Pull requests show up the moment they open
changes.body: Whether you or the agent opens, pushes or merges, the sidebar and status bar follow right away.

changes.title: Archiving asks about work that isn't pushed
changes.body: Push it and archive, archive anyway, or cancel. Moving a thread to another machine asks the same.

changes.title: Edited and queued messages no longer jump the chat
changes.body: An edited message shows its new words as soon as you send it, and a message queued behind a running turn leaves the chat where you are.

changes.title: Charts and tables the agent shows appear in its reply
Edit your last message
changes.body: Change what you sent and the agent starts over from there, with the files its reply changed put back.

changes.title: Open a thread in your editor or terminal
changes.body: Your editors, terminals and Finder sit in the top bar and open in the thread's folder.

changes.title: Copy a thread's link
changes.body: Paste it into a message to point the agent at that thread.

changes.title: Steer Codex while it works
changes.body: Codex takes a message at its next step, shows its reply as it writes it, and stops when you press Stop.

changes.title: Steer the agent while it works
changes.body: Send now and ⌘↵ give Claude your message at its next step instead of stopping it.

changes.title: An API for programs on your Mac
changes.body: Once you allow them, other programs can list and start threads, send messages and follow along, also over MCP; manage them in Settings › Ensemble API.

changes.title: A clearer chat
changes.body: The agent's work folds into one line above its reply, and what it asks of you and what you did each get a line of their own.

changes.title: Answer parts of a reply
changes.body: Select what the agent said, write your answer under it, and send your answers together as one message.

changes.title: Codex's newest models in the model menu
changes.body: GPT-6.1-Sol, GPT-6-Astra and the others Codex offers today, instead of GPT-5.5 alone.

changes.title: See how much of your Codex plan is used
changes.body: For ChatGPT sign-ins, your computer's own included, beside Claude's in the usage popover and in Settings.

changes.title: Side-by-side diffs
changes.body: Old and new side by side, unchanged lines folded, and only the words that changed marked.

changes.title: Replies start right away
changes.body: Your agent stays ready between messages, so the next one starts at once instead of after a few seconds.

changes.title: Settings as a page of their own
changes.body: Settings open over the whole window, with room for every section.

changes.title: Less memory over long sessions
changes.body: The app keeps only the chats you have open in full, and no longer grows the longer it runs.

changes.title: One button in the message box
changes.body: The mic while it's empty, send once you type, and Stop or Queue while the agent works.

changes.title: Usage shows percentages, and says when it's out of date
changes.body: Each window shows how much is used, and a reading that couldn't be refreshed is dimmed with its age.

changes.title: Agents waiting on a build or checks keep working
changes.body: What the agent left running in the background shows in the chat until it finishes, and the agent carries on from there instead of stopping at done.

changes.title: Your Mac stays responsive with many threads
changes.body: Archiving and deleting threads no longer slows your Mac down or leaves the app looking disconnected.

changes.title: Long chats scroll smoothly
changes.body: They no longer flicker as you scroll, and open on their newest messages at once.

changes.title: Questions from the agent stay as wide as the message box
Updates no longer pull the app to the front on Windows
changes.body: A new version downloads in the background and goes in when you restart. On Linux too.

changes.title: /compact and skills run when you type them
changes.body: They reached the agent as plain text.

changes.title: Reopening or forking a thread no longer pings that it's done
The iPhone app and Ensemble Cloud
changes.body: With them go the inbox, online mode and thread summaries; Ensemble runs threads on your computer and in cloud sandboxes.

changes.title: Threads on your own servers over SSH
Helper chats and sub-threads
changes.body: With notes between threads, combining threads, the Lead and the autonomy setting. Side chats and to-dos stay.

changes.title: See what's new in every version
changes.body: In Settings › What's new, and in the update popup.

changes.title: Start a thread from another thread's work or a branch
New thread opens as a page of its own
A cleaner light theme
An agent can fix a service that fails to start
changes.body: Send its error from the Running tab and the agent fixes the cause.

changes.title: A thread archives itself once its pull request merges
changes.body: Turn it off in Settings › Labs.

changes.title: Faster starts after an update
macOS no longer autocorrects what you type to the agent
Betas too works on Linux and Windows
Get new versions early
changes.body: Settings › General › Updates: choose Betas too to get each new version before everyone else.

changes.title: The app opens again after updating
changes.body: Some conversations made 0.2.8's window break as soon as it opened.

changes.title: No more crashes when a thread starts or stops working
changes.body: And if the window does break, it offers the update that fixes it.

changes.title: Stacked pull requests
changes.body: A thread can build on another's branch; its pull request merges after it.

changes.title: See when each usage limit resets
changes.body: The usage popover shows each agent's limits, when they reset, and whether you're on pace.

changes.title: Choose which logins to use, and when to switch
changes.body: In Settings › Agents, turn logins on or off and set the order they're used in.

changes.title: Updates never cut a running turn off
changes.body: Your machines update quietly in the background, and agents carry on where they were.

changes.title: Agents answer with pages of data
changes.body: Numbers, charts, tables, timelines and flows, drawn right in the reply in the app's own style.

changes.title: Agents can point you to another thread
changes.body: It shows as a chip you can click to open it.

changes.title: Ensemble VMs run folder projects
Code blocks with highlighting and a copy button
Ensemble for Windows
changes.body: Download the installer from the website.

changes.title: Merge conflicts go to the agent
changes.body: Press Merge on a pull request that conflicts, and the agent merges the base in for you.

changes.title: Check for updates from Settings
Dictate your messages
changes.body: Speak into the message box on a Mac, with Apple's speech recognition.

changes.title: Attach any file to a message
changes.body: Up to 5 MB each.

changes.title: Move a thread to a bigger VM
changes.body: From the move menu, or ask the agent when a build needs more room.

changes.title: Get started suggests your projects
changes.body: The repositories Claude Code and Codex have worked in are offered as projects.

changes.title: Take over a thread an agent started
changes.body: Threads an agent starts report to it, until you take one over.

changes.title: See when an update is ready
changes.body: Above the sidebar's foot, with a restart button.

changes.title: Archiving a thread with an open pull request asks first
Ensemble's first release
changes.body: Run Claude Code and Codex threads side by side, each in a machine of its own, on your Mac or your own servers.
